summary: Make a command result's reasoning and cited sources inspectable with operable source references.

useWhen.text: Use when a command result carries reasoning or sources so the person can inspect what the answer rests on.

avoidWhen.text: Avoid rendering an empty evidence box when the command returned neither reasoning nor sources.

keep.text: Exposes a named region holding the reasoning and cited sources.
Each cited source with a target exposes an operable link or button carrying the source title.
Fits a narrow viewport without horizontal overflow.
Keep reasoning and sources reachable without crowding the primary result.

customize.text: Present inline for high-stakes estimates or inside a disclosure when secondary to the main outcome.

default.text: Mount reasoning and sources from spec/wire/result-success-full.json with a named evidence region and an operable link to "Team guidelines".
